selectedAssets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production transparent RTS character walking sprite atlas for the existing Dai Viet villager.
Input images 1-4 are exact character and walking-pose references. Use ONLY the FOURTH (bottom) row, the basket-carrying civilian, in each reference. Ignore all other characters.
Create ONE new 1536x1024 PNG atlas with EXACTLY 16 isolated complete villagers, a regular 4 ROWS x 4 COLUMNS grid. Row 1 copies the bottom-row carrying poses in Image1 (contact A). Row2 copies the bottom-row carrying poses in Image2 (narrow passing D). Row3 copies the bottom-row carrying poses in Image3 (opposite contact B). Row4 copies the bottom-row carrying poses in Image4 (passing C).
The four columns maintain the references' headings in exactly the same order: front right/down-right, front left/down-left, back right/up-right, back left/up-left.
Primary request: replace ONLY the carried load and necessary fingers/hand grip in all 16 poses with a compact bundle of 4-5 short rough timber logs tied with two natural rope bands, clear pale circular cut ends and dark bark. No basket, no rice, no food. Both forearms realistically cradle the logs at waist height.
Preserve the SAME Dai Viet civilian identity, bandana, khaki coarse short tunic, dark cropped trousers, bare feet, realistic adult anatomy, muted earth colors, soft upper-left lighting, fixed isometric camera. Keep each reference row's leg poses and footfall, particularly the narrow passing poses. All 16 figures have the same anatomy and scale.
Each 384x256 grid cell centers exactly one COMPLETE head-to-feet figure about 208-216px tall, with transparent space above/below. Leave at least 24px total clear transparent separation between rows and ample column spacing. No overlapping figures or props. No detached body parts, no cropped feet, no extra copies, no weapons.
Genuinely transparent alpha background with EMPTY clear space. No gradient, colored backdrop, floor, ground shadow, checkerboard, grid, labels, text, logos or watermark. Render the carried material clearly enough to recognize at game scale.
selectedAssets.refinementPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input1 is the edit target: a 1536x1024 transparent 4x4 Dai Viet villager wood carrying sprite sheet. Input2 is ONLY a barefoot anatomy and NARROW PASSING leg-pose reference; use its BOTTOM row civilian, ignore all others.
Fix the following precise errors on Input1, keeping everything else unchanged:
1. ALL SIXTEEN villagers must have anatomically natural BARE FEET with visible toes and heel, the same skin color as their legs. Remove every slipper, shoe, sandal, boot and dark sole. Rows2 and3 currently mistakenly have footwear. Make bare feet on every row/view. No footwear anywhere.
2. Rows2 and4 are narrow PASSING poses in a walking cycle: knees pass close under hips, planted foot directly below body, opposite swing foot close behind with heel lifted and toes downward. Match the narrow passing civilian leg spacing in Input2 bottom row. Row2 left leg planted, row4 opposite leg planted. Keep the corresponding front/back views. Avoid wide running/split-leg strides in these two rows.
Retain EXACTLY 16 complete figures in 4 ROWS x4 COLUMNS, original heading order, original body/head height and identity, khaki tunic, bandana, cropped dark trousers, both arms carrying the SAME existing wood load with identical grip. Keep the cargo shapes/materials unchanged, no rice/grain unless already part of food (this is wood). Keep rows1 and3 existing contact leg poses except replacing their footwear with bare feet.
Do not change face, shoulders, clothes, carried material, lighting, upper body pose or scale. Clear transparent gaps between all rows/columns; no clipping at cell boundaries. Genuine transparent alpha, no backdrop, floor/shadow, grid, labels or text. Output one 1536x1024 PNG.
